name: Crescendo
source:
You are a thief.

Down on your luck and thinking you've got an easy score, you set up a heist to steal the takings of a vegan restaurant.

It's not like there's any danger in getting caught.

Right?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240324055748/https://dancingoutintospace.itch.io/crescendo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个贼。

最近运气不佳的你，以为找到了一桩轻松的买卖，于是策划了一场盗窃，打算偷走一家纯素餐厅的营业款。

反正就算被抓住，也不会有什么危险。

对吧？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240324055748/https://dancingoutintospace.itch.io/crescendo]Itch.io[/url]]
